product_metadata.title: WINIRINA Electric Wine Aerator Pourer Electric Smart Decanter，Dispenser Rechargeable with Micro USB Cable
features: EASY TO USE AND CLEAN： Place the electric wine aerator firmly into a bottle of wine, simply press the start button and watch as aerated wine is delivered to your wine glass full of enhanced flavors. Press again to stop, and not a splash of wine is dropped!

IMPROVED AERATION：Increases the oxidation of the tannins in red wine, removing astringency and drawing out the natural flavors without having to wait for the wine to breathe. At up to 5 times faster than a traditional wine aerator.

QUICK CHARGE AND AERATE MULTIPLE BOTTLES：With its in-built lithiumion battery, that fully recharges within 90 minutes, enough power is provided to fully aerate approximately 35 bottles of wine with a single charge.
PORTABLE AND SUITABLE TO STANDARD WINE BOTTLES：This wine gadget is fully portable, so be sure to take it when travelling or going to parties!
AN IDEAL GIFT FOR WINE LOVERS： With its elegant design and exceptional function. Consider it the perfect gift idea for a significant other or even a treat for yourself.
